Redragon VIPER M925 Wired RGB Gaming Mouse (24000 DPI)

Dominate esports arenas and unlock flawless targeting precision with the Redragon VIPER M925 Wired RGB Gaming Mouse. Available at Turbo Computer, this flagship hardware accessory is engineered for pro gamers who demand high-tier execution speed, effortless gliding, and ergonomic handling. Built with a heavy-duty pro layout and an advanced natural grip chassis, it stands as the definitive choice for competitive FPS/MMO setups and premium desktop configurations across Egypt looking for an immediate wired hardware modification.

The Redragon VIPER M925 Wired version features the highly efficient PixArt PAW3311 optical gaming sensor, expanding up to an advanced resolution layout of 24000 DPI via dedicated driver software. Engineered for tactical superiority, it features 10 fully programmable buttons for customized macros, 8 decent dynamic RGB backlit modes, and a premium dual-mode hyper-fast scroll wheel for rapid menu or weapon switching. With a stable 1000Hz polling rate environment and zero-latency wired tracking speeds, it guarantees top-tier daily performance.
